triage.kind_span: We may offer, from time to time, in one or more offerings, our common and/or fixed rate preferred shares, each with a par value $0.001 per share (together, shares), our promissory notes (notes), and/or our subscription rights to purchase our common and/or fixed rate preferred shares, which we refer to collectively as the securities.

notes: 424B2 filing of The GDL Fund's (NYSE: GDL) shelf BASE PROSPECTUS dated May 19, 2021 ($200,000,000 of common shares, preferred shares, notes and subscription rights; Registration Statement No. 333-250213). It sets no terms for any particular offering: the number of shares per right and other rights-offering terms are left to a future Prospectus Supplement, so no rights_offering event is extracted. The excerpt contains no prospectus supplement and ends inside 'Risk Factors and Special Considerations'. Mentions of the Series C Preferred Shares' redemption dates and the open-market repurchase authorisation (discount of 7.5% or more) are standing fund features, not an event of the schema's kinds.
